payload.claim: `CitationDefect`'s docstring describes itself as "One citation that fails the check, or the one mutant it drives." Nothing in this module creates, applies or drives a mutant: a `CitationDefect` is a citation-resolution defect, and `rewrite_moved_citations` only rewrites a range of text, never a find-and-replace edit against the subject code. 'Mutant' is a reserved term (a criterion-declared edit the `witness` gate applies) and CONTEXT.md explicitly rules it out for any other edit or artifact; using it here for an unrelated citation-defect value is both a vocabulary violation and a docstring claim the code does not back up, since no gate, lens or test reading this class would find a mutant anywhere near it.
